description: The four stat variants of the Puppet Nurse / Puppet Doctor (the hospital nightmare, map3_s03). A nurse or doctor spawn record names the variant it spawns as (index). Fields: health (Q12, 4096 = 1 point), stagger (the damage that knocks the nurse down, Q12), push (Q12), sight, wander, scale and attack (the behaviour's raw stat values), sound_bank (0 = nurse voice, 1 = doctor voice); clip_table selects the animation table (0 = puppet_nurse_a, 1 = puppet_nurse_b, tables/anim/*.json). The behaviour keeps its own copy of these values in STATS of chara/PuppetNurse/behavior.lua; change both together.
